column2: An agreement has brought Adam Kok's Philippolis district under the Orange Free State. Compensation closes one chapter of Griqua authority on the Orange frontier, while the western districts retain their own administration as Griqualand West. Kok and his followers now look eastward, seeking land where their community can rebuild its farms, congregations and political institutions. Their proposed settlement near Kokstad will require the consent of the authorities holding the district.
The Orange frontier enters a new chapter.
